claims.text: The paper explores various machine learning models for fake news detection, including convolutional neural networks (CNN), recurrent neural networks (RNN), feed-forward neural networks (FFNN), long-short term memory (LSTM), and logistic regression.
TraceMiner is an LSTM-RNN model that infers from social media user embeddings to classify messages, while FAKEDETECTOR is another model developed for detecting fake news credibility.
